Edge wrote: IF, Am I correct in seeing the BSZ as a area for the ITs to get their liquidity.

Absolutely!

Its the FL where we are looking to trade. not the BSZ itself. Its just another trap.

Yup. It's very often used to get the retailers trading in the right direction, then take their stops. They love to get sellers in who'll soon buy from them at an higher price, and buyers to sell at lower.

the BSZ itself is a indication the ITs are tricking and creating liquidity for themselves before price turns at our appropriate DP within the FL. We have to ask ourselves if we dont have a opportunity for ITs to get their liquidity on the approach, the turn in price is not as evident to us. So on the approach we want to see either:

- a BSZ -Compression - A swing hi low (to fake out)

Happy to be corrected

Yes.

But

As much as the ITs love to use what the retailers think they know against them, they also have to show sometimes that the retailers' conceptions are right.

I say this so you can decide upon your definite first target.

The common "breakout and retrace" has to occur often enough for retailers to still use it::

Remember: A lot of what we do is technical, but most of it is the application of an understanding of what the retailers think they know about the market.

So, from the image above, where is the massive probability trade from and to?

Once we've established that, we can go on to discuss its fine tuning and management.

خود BSZ نشانهٔ این است که IT‌ها دارند ترفند می‌زنند و پیش از چرخش قیمت در DP مناسب ما درون FL، برای خودشان نقدینگی می‌سازند. باید از خودمان بپرسیم اگر در مسیر نزدیک شدن فرصتی برای گرفتن نقدینگی IT‌ها نداشته باشیم، چرخش قیمت برایمان آن‌قدر واضح نیست. پس در مسیر نزدیک شدن می‌خواهیم یکی از این‌ها را ببینیم:

یک BSZ - فشردگی - یک سقف یا کف سوئینگ (برای فریب)

خوشحال می‌شوم اصلاحم کنی.

بله.

اما

IT‌ها هرچقدر هم که دوست داشته باشند آنچه معامله‌گرهای خرد فکر می‌کنند می‌دانند را علیه خودشان به کار ببرند، گاهی هم باید نشان دهند که تصورات خردها درست است.

این را می‌گویم تا بتوانی تارگت اول قطعی‌ات را تعیین کنی.

آن «شکست و برگشت» رایج باید به‌قدر کافی تکرار شود تا خردها هنوز از آن استفاده کنند::

یادت باشد: بخش زیادی از کاری که می‌کنیم تکنیکال است، اما بیشترش به کار بستن درکی از این است که خردها چه فکر می‌کنند دربارهٔ بازار می‌دانند.

پس با توجه به تصویر بالا، معاملهٔ با احتمال بالا از کجا تا کجاست؟

وقتی این را مشخص کردیم، می‌توانیم برویم سراغ ریزتنظیم و مدیریتش.

Yes quite True Linos. The only thing I would say is that because we do not need PA, the trade off is that we ought to really be looking at the approach and the clean orders we are leaning on. for example, lets use a 2DT example. even without space we can take the trade back to the 2DT kink

BUT

We need to be comfortable with the approach and reaction at our FL we are leaning on, plus they need to contain clean orders. So the trade off here is not having to worry so much about the space (as per diagram - QM has hit target) but we have to be more cautious than we ordinarily would with the approach and reaction.

Over at RTMA last year we had some discussions about scenario analysis which helps in these type of situations
